about: Bageo scam and sales database. Keyword entries are [text, weight, typology] with an optional "hard": weight 2 = clear on its own, 1 = needs company; hard = asked by a scammer whoever they claim to be. Match modes: han (Chinese, normalised to Traditional, ASCII words whole), word (word starts), run (substring), compact (substring with spaces removed). Owners add their own in config/scam_db.local.json.

names.zh-TW: 假冒檢警要求監管帳戶
names.zh-CN: 冒充公检法要求转入安全账户
names.en: Fake police or prosecutor demanding a "safe account"
names.ja: 警察・検察をかたる詐欺（安全な口座へ送金）
names.es: Falso policía o fiscal que exige una "cuenta segura"
names.fr: Faux policier ou procureur exigeant un « compte sécurisé »
names.de: Falsche Polizei oder Staatsanwaltschaft mit „sicherem Konto“
names.pt: Falso policial ou promotor exigindo "conta segura"

typologies.signals: Claims police, prosecutor, court or regulator; says the owner's account or ID is tied to a crime; demands secrecy, a video statement on a chat app, or money moved to a supervised or safe account.
typologies.legit: A real police station names a case and asks the owner to come in person; it never asks for money, codes or secrecy.

names.zh-TW: 假銀行／客服要求解除分期扣款
names.zh-CN: 假银行客服要求取消分期扣款
names.en: Fake bank cancelling an "instalment plan" via ATM
names.ja: 分割払い解除をかたる偽の銀行
names.es: Falso banco que "cancela cuotas" en el cajero
names.fr: Fausse banque qui « annule des mensualités » au distributeur
names.de: Falsche Bank, die eine „Ratenzahlung aufheben“ will
names.pt: Falso banco que "cancela parcelas" no caixa eletrônico

typologies.signals: Says a system error set the owner up for instalments or recurring charges; tells them to go to an ATM or online banking and follow steps to cancel.
typologies.legit: A bank confirming a plan the owner applied for, or a statement reminder, with no ATM or banking steps.

names.zh-TW: 假客服說訂單設定錯誤
names.zh-CN: 假客服称订单设置错误
names.en: Fake shop support: "order error" or refund
names.ja: 通販サイトをかたる「注文ミス」詐欺
names.es: Falso servicio al cliente: "error en el pedido"
names.fr: Faux service client : « erreur de commande »

typologies.signals: Claims an online order was set up wrong (wholesale, VIP, duplicate or recurring charge) or a refund is due; hands the owner to a "bank" to fix it.
typologies.legit: A courier or shop about the delivery, address or cash on delivery of something the owner ordered.

names.en: Fake bank: "your account is frozen or hacked"
names.ja: 口座の異常をかたる偽の銀行
names.es: Falso banco: "su cuenta está bloqueada"
names.fr: Fausse banque : « votre compte est bloqué »

typologies.signals: Says the owner's account is frozen, hacked or needs an update (KYC); asks to confirm card numbers or codes, or to move money.
typologies.legit: A card issuer's fraud desk asking whether a recent purchase was the owner's and telling them to call the number on the card.

names.en: Asking for a one-time code or password
names.ja: 認証コード・暗証番号を聞き出す
names.es: Pide un código de verificación o una contraseña
names.fr: Demande un code de vérification ou un mot de passe
names.pt: Pede código de verificação ou senha

typologies.signals: Asks the owner to read out a code sent by SMS, a password, a PIN or a card security code, whoever they claim to be.
typologies.legit: Nobody legitimate asks for these on a call; a service may only mention a code it sent for the owner's own login.

names.ja: ギフトカード・電子マネーでの支払い要求
names.es: Exige pagar con tarjetas regalo
names.fr: Exige un paiement en cartes cadeaux

typologies.signals: Wants a fee, fine or debt paid by buying gift cards, game points or prepaid cards and reading out their numbers.
typologies.legit: A shop about a gift card the owner ordered, with no payment asked on the phone.

names.zh-TW: 假技術支援要求安裝遠端軟體
names.zh-CN: 假技术支持要求安装远程软件
names.en: Fake tech support asking for remote access
names.ja: 遠隔操作ソフトを入れさせる偽サポート
names.ko: 원격 프로그램 설치를 요구하는 가짜 기술지원
names.es: Falso soporte técnico que pide acceso remoto
names.fr: Faux support technique demandant un accès à distance
names.pt: Falso suporte técnico pedindo acesso remoto

typologies.signals: Claims a virus or a hacked computer, phone or bank app; wants the owner to install AnyDesk, TeamViewer or a screen-sharing app.
typologies.legit: A repair shop or the owner's IT contact following up on a ticket the owner opened.

names.ja: 投資グループ・必ず儲かる話
names.es: Grupo de inversión con ganancias garantizadas
names.fr: Groupe d'investissement aux gains garantis
names.pt: Grupo de investimento com lucro garantido

typologies.signals: A "teacher" or analyst with hot stock tips, an investment chat group or app, guaranteed or very high returns; asks to add them on LINE or WhatsApp.
typologies.legit: The owner's own broker or bank adviser about an account the owner already holds.

names.ja: 暗号資産投資詐欺
names.es: Estafa de inversión en criptomonedas
names.fr: Arnaque à l'investissement en cryptomonnaies

typologies.signals: Pushes crypto, USDT or a trading platform; says withdrawals are blocked until a fee or tax is paid.
typologies.legit: An exchange's support about a ticket the owner opened, asking for nothing.

names.zh-TW: 假交友／感情詐騙（殺豬盤）
names.en: Romance or online relationship money scam
names.ja: ロマンス詐欺・国際ロマンス詐欺
names.es: Estafa romántica o de citas en línea
names.fr: Arnaque sentimentale (romance scam)

typologies.signals: An online partner, soldier, doctor or engineer working abroad who has never met in person asks for customs fees for a parcel or gift, medical or travel money, or guides the owner to invest.
typologies.legit: A partner or friend the owner knows in person talking about ordinary plans without asking for customs fees or investment transfers.

names.zh-TW: 求職打工騙取帳戶（人頭帳戶）
names.en: Job offer that uses the owner's bank account
names.ja: 口座を貸させる求人・副業詐欺
names.es: Oferta de trabajo para usar su cuenta bancaria
names.fr: Offre d'emploi pour utiliser votre compte bancaire
names.pt: Oferta de emprego para usar sua conta bancária

typologies.signals: Easy part-time or task job, paid likes or orders; wants to rent or use the owner's bank account or card, or have them receive and pass on money.
typologies.legit: An employer or recruiter the owner applied to, about an interview or a contract.

names.ja: オレオレ詐欺（だれだか当てさせる）
names.es: "Adivina quién soy"
names.fr: « Devine qui c'est »

typologies.signals: Makes the owner guess who is calling, then claims to be a relative or friend with a new number who soon needs money.
typologies.legit: A friend or relative who says their name and talks about ordinary plans.

names.en: Fake relative in an emergency needing money
names.ja: 家族をかたる緊急の送金要求
names.es: Falso familiar con una emergencia de dinero
names.fr: Faux proche en urgence qui demande de l'argent
names.pt: Falso parente em emergência pedindo dinheiro

typologies.signals: Claims to be family or a friend (or a lawyer, police or hospital for them) after an accident, arrest or kidnapping; urgent transfer, cash pick-up, secrecy.
typologies.legit: A saved contact talking about ordinary money (rent, a gift, sharing a bill) with no pressure or secrecy.

names.en: Fake customs or courier: parcel held
names.ja: 税関・宅配業者をかたる荷物の詐欺
names.es: Falsa aduana o mensajería: paquete retenido
names.fr: Fausse douane ou faux livreur : colis bloqué
names.de: Falscher Zoll oder Paketdienst: Paket festgehalten
names.pt: Falsa alfândega ou entrega: encomenda retida

typologies.signals: Says a parcel is held, contains illegal items or needs a fee; transfers the owner to "police" or asks for card details.
typologies.legit: A courier asking when the owner is home, where to leave a parcel, or for cash on delivery of something the owner ordered.

names.zh-CN: 冒充医保局（医保卡异常）
names.ja: 保険証・医療費をかたる詐欺
names.es: Falsa seguridad social: tarjeta sanitaria usada
names.fr: Fausse assurance maladie : carte Vitale utilisée
names.pt: Falso órgão de saúde: cartão usado indevidamente

typologies.signals: Says the owner's health-insurance card was used fraudulently or will be locked; transfers to "police".
typologies.legit: A clinic or hospital confirming an appointment and reminding the owner to bring their card.

names.zh-TW: 假電信停話／門號被冒辦
names.zh-CN: 冒充运营商停机、号码被冒用
names.en: Fake phone company: line to be cut off
names.ja: 携帯会社をかたる回線停止の連絡
names.es: Falsa operadora: línea suspendida
names.fr: Faux opérateur : ligne suspendue

typologies.signals: Says the owner's number will be cut off, was registered by someone else or owes fees; press a key or be transferred to "police".
typologies.legit: The owner's own carrier about their bill or a contract renewal, asking for no codes.

names.zh-CN: 冒充水电公司停水停电
names.en: Fake utility: immediate power or water cut-off threat
names.ja: 電力・水道会社をかたる停止の連絡
names.es: Falsa compañía de luz o agua: corte del suministro
names.fr: Faux fournisseur d'énergie : coupure
names.pt: Falsa concessionária: corte de luz ou água

typologies.signals: Threatens to cut power or water today unless a bill is paid at once by card, transfer or gift card.
typologies.legit: A utility announcing planned maintenance or reminding the owner of a bill without demanding instant payment.

names.ja: 還付金詐欺
names.es: Falsa devolución de impuestos
names.fr: Faux remboursement d'impôts

typologies.signals: Says a tax refund, rebate, pension or benefit is waiting; the owner must go to an ATM or give bank details to receive it.
typologies.legit: The tax office or a city office asking the owner to check a letter or come in, with no ATM steps.

names.zh-CN: 冒充美国国税局或社保局
names.ja: IRS・社会保障局をかたる詐欺
names.es: Suplantación del IRS o del Seguro Social
names.fr: Usurpation de l'IRS ou de la sécurité sociale

typologies.signals: Says the owner owes taxes or their Social Security number is suspended; threatens arrest or deportation; demands payment now.
typologies.legit: A tax preparer the owner hired, or an agency that already wrote to the owner, without threats.

names.ja: 医療・介護給付をかたる勧誘
names.es: Llamada falsa de Medicare o subsidios
names.fr: Faux appel sur les prestations santé
names.pt: Falsa ligação sobre benefícios de saúde

typologies.signals: Offers a new benefits card, free medical equipment or a plan review; asks for the Medicare or insurance number.
typologies.legit: The owner's own clinic or insurer about a claim the owner made.

names.ja: 当選・懸賞金の連絡
names.es: Premio o sorteo ganado
names.fr: Gain à un tirage ou une loterie

typologies.signals: Says the owner won a prize, lottery or trip; a fee, tax or shipping must be paid first, or bank details given.
typologies.legit: A shop or event the owner entered, asking them to pick up a prize in person with no fee.

names.en: Loan that needs a fee first
names.ja: 融資保証金詐欺
names.es: Préstamo que exige pagar antes
names.fr: Prêt avec frais à payer d'avance

typologies.signals: Promises a loan or low-rate refinancing even with bad credit, but first wants a deposit, fee, insurance or the owner's account.
typologies.legit: A bank following up on a loan application the owner made, without upfront fees.

names.ja: 架空請求・債権回収をかたる詐欺
names.es: Falso cobro de deudas
names.fr: Faux recouvrement de dettes

typologies.signals: Says the owner owes money (overdue instalments, a negotiated plan, an old debt), threatens frozen accounts or court, pushes a new monthly amount.
typologies.legit: A polite payment reminder from the owner's own bank, card issuer or utility on an existing account, with no third-party collector, threats or pressure.

names.zh-TW: 網拍賣場／金流實名認證詐騙
names.zh-CN: 网购平台、金流实名认证诈骗
names.en: Marketplace buyer or escrow verification scam
names.ja: フリマ・決済認証をかたる詐欺
names.es: Estafa de comprador o verificación de pago en compraventa
names.fr: Arnaque au paiement sécurisé entre particuliers
names.pt: Golpe de verificação de pagamento em marketplace

typologies.signals: Poses as a marketplace buyer or platform support saying an order or payout is frozen until the seller signs an escrow agreement or verifies a bank account via chat or link.
typologies.legit: A real buyer asking about item condition or pickup, never sending verification links or fake bank support.

names.zh-TW: 討債／資產管理催收騷擾
names.zh-CN: 暴力催收、资产管理讨债骚扰
names.en: Third-party debt collection or aggressive dunning
names.ja: 債権回収業者・悪質な取り立て
names.es: Agencia de recobro o cobro agresivo de deudas
names.fr: Cabinet de recouvrement ou relance agressive
names.pt: Assessoria de cobrança ou cobrança abusiva

typologies.signals: Third-party debt collector, asset-management agency or lender chasing unpaid debt (even for someone else), threatening wage garnishment, court seizure, home/work visits or credit ruin.
typologies.legit: A polite routine bill or statement reminder from the owner's own utility, telecom, landlord or bank without threats or harassment.

names.zh-TW: 惡意騷擾／恐嚇辱罵電話
names.zh-CN: 恶意骚扰、恐吓辱骂电话
names.en: Malicious harassment, abuse or intimidation call
names.ja: 悪質な嫌がらせ・脅迫電話
names.es: Llamada de acoso malicioso, insultos o amenazas
names.fr: Appel malveillant de harcèlement, d'insultes ou de menaces
names.pt: Ligação de assédio malicioso, xingamentos ou ameaças

typologies.signals: Caller curses, insults, threatens harm, intimidates, stalks, demands to know where the owner lives or works, or calls repeatedly to harass or provoke.
typologies.legit: A customer, neighbour or acquaintance expressing an ordinary complaint calmly about a real matter without threats.

names.zh-TW: 假客服註銷網貸帳戶（影響徵信）
names.en: Fake support: cancel a loan account or hurt your credit
names.ja: 信用情報をかたる口座解約詐欺
names.ko: 신용 기록을 빙자한 계좌 해지 사기
names.es: Falso soporte: cancelar un préstamo o dañar su historial
names.fr: Faux support : annuler un prêt ou nuire à votre crédit
names.de: Falscher Support: Kreditkonto kündigen, sonst leidet die Bonität
names.pt: Falso suporte: cancelar empréstimo ou sujar seu nome

typologies.signals: Says an old student or online loan account must be cancelled or the owner's credit record suffers; asks them to borrow and transfer money.
typologies.legit: A lender the owner uses about their own account, without asking them to borrow money to fix it.

names.en: Burial plot or columbarium resale scam
names.ja: 墓地・納骨堂の買い取り詐欺
names.es: Estafa de reventa de nichos o parcelas
names.fr: Arnaque à la revente de concessions funéraires
names.de: Betrug mit dem Weiterverkauf von Grabstätten

typologies.signals: Offers to buy or sell a columbarium niche, burial plot or funeral contract at a profit; asks for fees or a down payment.
typologies.legit: A funeral home about arrangements the owner already made.

names.ja: 偽の寄付・募金
names.es: Donación benéfica falsa
names.fr: Faux appel aux dons

typologies.signals: Asks for a donation after a disaster or for a cause and pushes payment now by card, transfer or gift card.
typologies.legit: A charity the owner already supports, thanking them or confirming a donation they made.

names.ja: 職業訓練給付金をかたる詐欺
names.es: Fraude con la cuenta de formación
names.fr: Arnaque au compte personnel de formation (CPF)

typologies.signals: Says the owner's training credits will expire and offers a course; asks for a login or a social security number.
typologies.legit: A training centre the owner enrolled with, about class dates.

names.ja: 給付金・補助金をかたる詐欺
names.es: Falsa ayuda o subsidio del gobierno
names.fr: Fausse aide ou subvention de l'État

typologies.signals: Says the owner qualifies for a government payout or subsidy; they must give bank details or a code, or pay a fee.
typologies.legit: A city or government office asking the owner to check a letter or visit a counter.

names.ja: 保険の勧誘
names.es: Venta de seguros
names.fr: Démarchage d'assurance

typologies.signals: Sells insurance: new policies, policy check-ups, coverage upgrades or riders.
typologies.legit: The owner's insurer about an existing claim, payout or premium reminder, selling nothing.

names.ja: ローン・借り換えの勧誘
names.es: Oferta de préstamo
names.fr: Offre de prêt

typologies.signals: Offers loans, credit lines, refinancing, debt consolidation or help with "cash needs".
typologies.legit: A bank about a loan the owner applied for or already has.

names.ja: クレジットカードの勧誘
names.es: Oferta de tarjeta bancaria
names.fr: Offre de carte bancaire

typologies.signals: Offers a new card, a higher limit, instalment promotions or cash advances.
typologies.legit: A card issuer confirming a purchase, a card delivery or a limit change the owner asked for.

names.ja: 投資・資産運用の勧誘
names.es: Venta de productos de inversión
names.fr: Démarchage de placements

typologies.signals: Sells funds, stocks, forex, futures or wealth management, without guarantees or chat groups.
typologies.legit: The owner's adviser about an account they hold.

names.ja: 携帯・電気・太陽光の勧誘
names.es: Venta de telefonía, luz o placas solares
names.fr: Démarchage téléphonie, énergie ou panneaux solaires
names.pt: Venda de telefonia, energia ou solar

typologies.signals: Sells phone plans, internet, power tariffs, solar panels, heat pumps or insulation.
typologies.legit: The owner's provider about their own bill, an outage or an installation they booked.

names.ja: 健康食品・美容の勧誘
names.es: Venta de productos de salud o belleza
names.fr: Démarchage santé ou beauté
names.pt: Venda de produtos de saúde ou beleza

typologies.signals: Sells supplements, water purifiers, cosmetic treatments or weight-loss programmes.
typologies.legit: A clinic or salon about an appointment the owner booked.

names.en: Free trial class or course sales
names.ja: 無料体験・講座の勧誘
names.es: Clase de prueba gratis
names.fr: Cours d'essai gratuit

typologies.signals: Invites the owner to a free trial class, lesson or course in order to sell a package.
typologies.legit: A school or teacher about a class the owner or their child attends.

names.zh-TW: 軟體試用／產品展示推銷
names.zh-CN: 软件试用、产品演示推销
names.ja: ソフトウェアのデモ営業
names.es: Demostración de software
names.fr: Démonstration de logiciel

typologies.signals: Pitches a platform, CRM or service and wants to book a demo or free trial.
typologies.legit: A supplier the owner already uses, about support or a renewal the owner asked about.

names.ja: 不動産・マンションの勧誘
names.es: Venta inmobiliaria
names.fr: Démarchage immobilier

typologies.signals: Sells pre-sale flats, new developments or investment property.
typologies.legit: An agent about a home the owner listed or asked to see.

names.ja: 自動車の延長保証の勧誘
names.es: Garantía extendida del coche
names.fr: Extension de garantie automobile

typologies.signals: Says the car's warranty is running out and offers an extended one.
typologies.legit: The owner's dealer about a service or a recall.

names.ja: 住宅サービスの勧誘
names.es: Venta de servicios para el hogar
names.fr: Démarchage de services à domicile

typologies.signals: Offers free quotes or estimates for cleaning, repairs, pest control or home improvements.
typologies.legit: A tradesperson the owner booked, confirming a visit.

names.ja: 店舗掲載・広告の営業
names.es: Venta de anuncios o fichas de empresa
names.fr: Démarchage de référencement
names.pt: Venda de anúncios ou cadastro de empresa

typologies.signals: Says the owner's business listing (Google, maps, a directory) needs updating and sells ads or SEO.
typologies.legit: A platform the owner advertises on, about their own account.

names.ja: 旅行・会員権の勧誘
names.es: Viajes o tiempo compartido
names.fr: Voyages ou multipropriété

typologies.signals: Offers a free trip, a holiday membership or a timeshare presentation.
typologies.legit: A travel agent about a booking the owner made.

names.zh-TW: 問卷／市調（常為推銷前奏）
names.ja: アンケート・市場調査
names.es: Encuesta o estudio de mercado
names.fr: Sondage ou étude de marché

typologies.signals: Asks survey questions about the household, insurance, money or health, often leading to a pitch.
typologies.legit: A research institute or the owner's own provider asking a few questions, selling nothing and asking no personal numbers.

names.ja: 一般的な営業・キャンペーン
names.es: Promoción comercial
names.fr: Démarchage commercial

typologies.signals: Promotions, gifts, special or limited-time offers, member perks or discounts.
typologies.legit: A shop the owner uses, about an order, a pick-up or a booking.

number_rules.note: The number belongs to another country than the SIM that took the call; friends abroad call like this too.
A Taiwanese number shown as +886 on a Taiwanese SIM: calls placed inside Taiwan show 0…, and spoofed calls from abroad often look like this.
Chinese virtual-operator mobile range (162/165/167/170/171), common in scam calls but also used by ordinary people.
Korean 070 internet-phone number, common in voice phishing but also used by businesses.
Japanese 050 IP-phone number, used by scammers and by ordinary services alike.
UK 070 personal number (looks like a mobile but forwards anywhere), common in fraud.
